summary: Zedge filed an 8-K on Sep 10, 2026, disclosing a Sep 8 and Sep 10 Securities Purchase Agreement (Item 1.01) for a private placement of 2,616,447 Class B shares and warrants to purchase 2,354,803 Class B shares for aggregate proceeds of $7,675,000, or $2.98/$2.93 per share with 90% warrant coverage. Purchasers include Vice Chairman Howard Jonas ($6.5 million), Director Elliot Gibber ($650,000), and one other current stockholder ($525,000). Warrants strike at 110% of the per-share price ($3.22/$3.28), expire five years from initial exercise, and require NYSE American stockholder approval before exercise; purchasers abstain. This is a related-party private financing, not a special situation.
